faq.title:
Frequently
asked
questions
faq.q1: What do I get with a premium subscription?
faq.a1: Full access to exclusive articles, advanced video explanations, company-filtered questions, and premium solutions. Plus a special profile badge and full access to the Fuzzi – QA Tools mobile app on iOS & Android.
faq.q2: What are premium solutions? Can I see a sample?
faq.a2: Step-by-step guides written by engineers who've been in the trench. Multiple approaches, complexity analysis, interactive snippets. Not recycled bootcamp material.
faq.q3: How do you group questions by company?
faq.a3: We aggregate and verify interview experiences shared by the community. Company tags stay current because the market doesn't wait.
faq.q4: What if I subscribe and want to cancel?
faq.a4: Cancel anytime from your account settings. You keep access until the end of your billing cycle. No questions asked. No hard feelings.
faq.q5: Can I lock in my current rate?
faq.a5: Yes. As long as your subscription stays active, your price is frozen. Future price hikes won't touch you.
